numeric_scores: finite JSON numbers in [0,1]; boolean/string coercion forbidden
network_classifier: Python ipaddress.is_private/is_loopback plus case-insensitive whole-word vpn|proxy|tor; heuristic, not VPN proof
arithmetic: decimal representation of validated numbers; sum weighted contributions; no intermediate rounding
pass_threshold: risk_score < default_threshold; equality does not pass
limitations: Version identifies current Module 3 numerical semantics, not team approval of every missing-signal rule.
A risk pass is not biometric success or permission to approve attendance.
Unavailable, disabled and missing are different caller states; this legacy input schema cannot distinguish them.
Required biometric evidence must be checked by Module 2 BEFORE scoring or fallback.
Device signatures lack a signed server challenge; no signature authenticity is established.
Geolocation risk measures accuracy/validity, not distance to a course venue.
Pin the Python/ipaddress runtime and run the shared corpus before enabling a fallback; finite tests are not a proof of equivalence.
